_instructions: Lets CloudFormation set each scheduled function's failure destination
(EventInvokeConfig in template.yaml). A separate managed policy because the
main deployer policy is close to IAM's 6,144-character limit.
Copy this file to iam-deployer-invoke-config-policy.json, replace
YOUR_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, and create it via IAM → Policies → Create policy → JSON.
Attach it to the deployer user and to the GitHub deploy role (secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN).
